project: Is it possible to live permanently on another planet?
scientific_conclusion: Permanent off-Earth habitation is not currently demonstrated. A credible bounded-autonomy claim requires commodity-specific closure, resilient power and thermal control, qualified and repairable ISRU, human-safety margins, and recovery from correlated failures without hidden routine Earth support. ISS ECLSS and MOXIE are enabling evidence, not proof of independent settlement.
independent_review_reason: The deliverable is a static, design-only research document with no high-risk architecture, security, persistence, or data-migration modification.
